notes.note: Heeney had 15 handballs to go with his 9 kicks. Not a huge score but it was his 58% efficiency that hurt the score. He also sat much of the last term.
Heeney slotted two goals from his 22 disposals. This was his first over 100 in the last month as he has had Errol in the midfield helping him out.
Heeney was tagged but still managed 25 disposals and a goal. It was also his first under 800 since round 13.
Heeney copped a cork to the lower back during the game but played it out after some side line treatment. He still had 16 contested possessions and 29 disposals.
Heeney scored just 9 points after half time when the Dockers took over the match. He wasn't the only Swan to go missing.
Heeney continues his good form with his 27 disposals and 6 tackles. In just over 50k of teams he is certainly delivering for his owners.
Heeney is up to 5 over 100 in a row now with this week's 30 disposal 7 clearance game. There is no doubting his scoring ability and a safe trade in option for you.
Heeney had Drew following him but that didn't stop him having 30 disposals. All it did affect was his efficiency which was down at 53% as Port put plenty of pressure on the Swans ball carriers.
Heeney got some attention from the Saints but still had the 30 disposals and 6 tackles. He was the best scoring Swan.
Heeney was the star of the game with 5 goals from 32 disposals and 7 marks. A massive game from him as the Swans recorded an easy win. He will be a heavy trade in after his bye.
Heeney copped the Mullin but did manage 23 disposals and 8 tackles and he also had the equal most clearances for the game with 8.
Heeney had 20 contested disposals and 11 clearances to be second in both categories for the game to Grundy. This was his first under 100 since round 1 but there wasn't much in it!
Heeney was one of just two Swans to crack triple figures this week with 15 contested possessions 7 clearances and 3 goals.
Heeney had a great game with 33 disposals of which 22 were by hand. He has been on a great run in his last four games.
Heeney missed the game with some calf soreness and it is hoped he will return this week.
28 disposals for Heeney in the win making it three over 100 in a row now for him. He is always an option for us . If he does get forward status he will be a must own.

Heeney was the star of the game and did it all leading the game in clearances contested possessions and disposals. Don't expect this every week but with a very low BE this would be the time to get him in.
Heeney's return to the team was a fantastic one with 4 goals from his 26 disposals and 8 marks. He beat his BE and now has one of 98. Heeney is always one we need to be aware of as a possible target
Heeney left the game in the last quarter with a hamstring issue. He is likely to miss this week with the short turn around to Thurs night however is expected to return for the following game.
Heeney looks to have a similar role and one that will see some big scores but he will often deliver these just short of 100.
